prose:
A short project page presents a ChatGPT-themed SNES experience with controller-style input and downloadable console files. It states hardware-support requirements but supplies little readable information about the underlying model or whether responses come from a remote service.

The project was not downloaded or run. Its title does not establish that a full modern ChatGPT model runs natively on the console, and functionality, accuracy and security were not tested.
highlights: Hardware requirements are stated by the project
Model architecture is not explained in the excerpt
No native modern-model inference claim is verified
